task.ques: Show the average price of movie ticket in Providence, Nashville, Boise in 2023.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: In 2023, the average movie ticket price was $14.37 in Providence, Rhode Island; $13.30 in Nashville, Tennessee; and $11.60 in Boise, Idaho (US dollars).

Evidence: Wolfram|Alpha's Results lists these as the mean prices for Quarter 1 through Quarter 4 of 2023, based on the C2ER retail price survey.
Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=average+price+of+movie+ticket+in+Providence%2C+Nashville%2C+Boise+in+2023
Screenshot: final.png shows the three cities, movie ticket, 2023, and all three mean prices together.
